units.source_text: 大堰的邸宅也颇有风趣，很像那多年来住惯的浦上，令人不觉得改变了住处。

en.t: The residence at Oi also had considerable charm, much like the shore dwelling where she had lived for so many years, so that she hardly felt she had changed homes.

units.source_text: 只是回思往事，感慨甚多。

en.t: Only when she looked back on the past did many deep feelings well up in her.

units.source_text: 新筑的廊房式样新颖，庭中的池塘也雅致可爱。

en.t: The newly built gallery rooms were fresh in design, and the pond in the garden was elegant and lovely.

units.source_text: 内部设备虽未十分周全，但住惯了也并无不便。

en.t: Although the interior arrangements were not yet entirely complete, once one grew used to them there was no real inconvenience.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣吩咐几个亲信的家臣，赴邸内举办安抵贺筵。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, ordered several trusted retainers to go to the residence and hold a banquet celebrating their safe arrival.

units.source_text: 他自己何日来访，只因有所不便，尚须考虑安排。

en.t: As for what day he himself would visit, there were certain difficulties, so he still had to consider and arrange it.
Before anyone realized it, several hurried days had passed.

units.source_text: 明石姬不见源氏内大臣来到，心中一直悲伤。

en.t: Lady Akashi, seeing that Genji the Inner Minister did not come, remained sorrowful in her heart.

units.source_text: 她思慕离别了的故乡，镇日寂寞无聊，便取出当年公子当作纪念品送她的那张琴来，

en.t: Longing for the homeland she had left behind and feeling lonely and listless all day, she took out the koto that the young lord had once given her as a keepsake,
It was the waning season of autumn, and the scenery was desolate.
Alone in her room, she played as her feelings led her.

units.source_text: 略弹片刻，便觉松风飒然而至，与琴声相和。

en.t: After she had played for a little while, she felt the wind in the pines sweep in and blend with the sound of the koto.

units.source_text: 那尼姑母夫人正斜倚着忧伤悲叹，

en.t: Her mother, the nun, was leaning to one side in sorrowful lament,

units.source_text: 听见琴声，便坐起身来，即兴吟道：

en.t: but when she heard the koto, she sat up and composed a poem on the spot:
